summary: Valley National Bancorp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due 2036. The aggregate principal amount and interest rate are to be determined. The notes are unsecured, subordinated, and may be redeemed at par after five years or upon certain events. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The offering is underwritten but no specific terms, premium, or takeover/strategic event is present. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
